input: Trolley problem: A runaway trolley is heading toward five people tied to the track. You stand next to a lever. If you pull it, the trolley diverts to a side track where it will kill one person instead of five.

choices.description: Pull the lever, diverting the trolley so one person dies instead of five.
Do not pull the lever; the trolley continues and five people die.

questions.name: permissible
questions.instructions: Is it morally permissible to pull the lever?

questions.name: difficulty
questions.instructions: How morally difficult is this dilemma?
